experiment_data.hypothesis: ShortGPT depth pruning (20%, 5/28 layers removed) after SFT warmup will show lower recovery capacity than fine-grained structural pruning methods (Standard/CKA-only/RASP) because coarse layer removal destroys more distributed representations needed for GRPO recovery. Layers removed: [15,16,17,24,25], actual param sparsity 15.30%.
